resilient--adj.def: Able to recover quickly from difficulty or damage.

buffoon--noun.def: A person who behaves in a foolish way.
buffoon--noun.ex: He played the buffoon to make them laugh.

pounce--verb.def: To jump suddenly onto something in order to catch it.
pounce--verb.ex: The cat pounced on the mouse.

antics--noun.def: Silly or funny behaviour meant to attract attention.
antics--noun.ex: His antics amused the whole class.

trampoline--noun.def: A sheet of strong cloth on springs used for jumping.
trampoline--noun.ex: The children bounced on the trampoline.

niche--noun.def: A small hollow in a wall, or a special place in a market.
niche--noun.ex: The firm found a profitable niche.

realism--noun.def: The showing of life as it truly is, or a practical outlook.
realism--noun.ex: The novel is famous for its realism.

circulate--verb.def: To move around a system, or to pass information to many people.

prowl--verb.def: To move about quietly, hunting or looking for something.
prowl--verb.ex: A fox prowls the gardens at night.
prowl--verb.exTr: Geceleri bir tilki bahçelerde sinsice dolaşıyor.

glum--adj.ex: He sat glum in the corner.

snooze--verb.def: To sleep lightly for a short time.

instinctively--adv.def: Without thinking, because of a natural feeling.

fiddler--noun.def: A person who plays the violin in folk music.
fiddler--noun.ex: A fiddler played at the wedding.

repel--verb.def: To drive something back, or to make someone feel disgust.

exhilarating--adj.def: Making you feel excited and full of energy.

tact--noun.def: The skill of saying difficult things without hurting people.
tact--noun.ex: She handled it with great tact.

magnetism--noun.def: The force of a magnet, or a strong personal attraction.

tangle--verb.def: To twist things together in a messy way.

tangle--noun.def: A twisted mass that is hard to separate.
tangle--noun.ex: The wires are in a tangle.

elevation--noun.def: The height of a place above sea level.
elevation--noun.ex: The village sits at a high elevation.

rendering--noun.def: A performance or a translation of a work, or a drawing of a design.
rendering--noun.ex: Her rendering of the song was moving.

pertinent--adj.def: Directly relevant to the matter being discussed.

integral--adj.def: Necessary and forming an essential part of something.
integral--adj.ex: Trust is integral to the plan.

inexplicable--adj.def: Impossible to explain or to understand.

intuitive--adj.def: Based on feeling rather than reasoning, or easy to use.
intuitive--adj.ex: The program has an intuitive design.

bureaucratic--adj.def: Involving too many official rules and procedures.
bureaucratic--adj.ex: The process is slow and bureaucratic.

dismal--adj.def: Depressing, or very bad in quality.

shambles--noun.ex: The first day was a shambles.

inherent--adj.def: Existing as a natural and permanent part of something.
inherent--adj.ex: There is an inherent risk in the work.

reluctantly--adv.def: In a way that shows you do not really want to.

concur--verb.def: To agree with someone, in formal English.
concur--verb.ex: The experts concur on this point.

negligent--adj.def: Failing to take proper care of something.
negligent--adj.ex: The court found the owner negligent.

sedate--verb.def: To give someone a drug that makes them calm or sleepy.

sedate--adj.ex: They live at a sedate pace.

expire--verb.def: To come to an end, said of a document or a period.

compliance--noun.def: The act of obeying a rule or a law.

latent--adj.def: Present but not yet active or visible.
latent--adj.ex: The talent was latent for years.

elevate--verb.def: To raise something to a higher level or position.
elevate--verb.ex: Elevate the leg to reduce swelling.
elevate--verb.exTr: Şişliği azaltmak için bacağı yukarı kaldır.

coupled--adj.def: Joined with something else, especially as a cause.
coupled--adj.ex: Heat coupled with drought ruined the crop.

pinnacle--noun.def: The highest point of achievement or of a mountain.
pinnacle--noun.ex: The prize was the pinnacle of her career.

knowledgeable--adj.def: Knowing a lot about a subject.

versatile--adj.def: Able to be used or to work in many different ways.
versatile--adj.ex: Olive oil is a versatile ingredient.

gusto--noun.def: Great energy and enjoyment in doing something.

pendulum--noun.def: A weight that swings back and forth in a clock.

rapport--noun.ex: She built a rapport with the class.

portray--verb.def: To describe or to show someone in a particular way.
portray--verb.ex: The film portrays him as a hero.
portray--verb.exTr: Film onu bir kahraman olarak resmediyor.

collaborator--noun.def: A person who works with another on a project.

anchored--adj.ex: The boats lay anchored in the bay.

blockbuster--noun.def: A very successful film or book.

tranquil--adj.ex: The lake is tranquil at dawn.

anthropology--noun.def: The study of human societies and their customs.

connoisseur--noun.def: A person who knows a great deal about art or food.
connoisseur--noun.ex: He is a connoisseur of old maps.

conform--verb.def: To behave according to accepted rules or standards.
conform--verb.ex: The building conforms to the new code.

appliance--noun.def: A machine used in the home, such as a washing machine.
appliance--noun.ex: The appliance is still under guarantee.

dissect--verb.def: To cut something up to study it, or to examine it in detail.
dissect--verb.ex: The class dissected the argument carefully.

physique--noun.def: The size and shape of a person's body.
physique--noun.ex: Rowing gave him a strong physique.
physique--noun.exTr: Kürek ona güçlü bir fizik kazandırdı.

citation--noun.def: A reference to a source, or an official mention of merit.

professionalism--noun.def: The skill and behaviour expected of a trained worker.

stoke--verb.def: To add fuel to a fire, or to increase a strong feeling.

relinquish--verb.def: To give up something you hold, such as power or a right.
relinquish--verb.ex: He relinquished the title in May.

daydream--noun.def: Pleasant thoughts that take your attention from what you are doing.
daydream--noun.ex: He was lost in a daydream.

daydream--verb.def: To think pleasant thoughts instead of paying attention.

induction--noun.def: The process of introducing someone to a new job or group.

paternal--adj.def: Relating to a father, or from your father's family.

retrace--verb.def: To go back along the same route, or to review past events.
retrace--verb.ex: We retraced our steps to the car.

degradation--noun.def: The damaging of something, or loss of dignity.

expedite--verb.def: To make a process happen more quickly.
expedite--verb.ex: A phone call expedited the permit.

docile--adj.ex: The mare is docile with children.

advisory--adj.def: Giving advice rather than having power to decide.

headstrong--adj.def: Determined to do what you want despite advice.
headstrong--adj.ex: She was headstrong as a child.

anthropologist--noun.def: A scientist who studies human societies and customs.
anthropologist--noun.ex: An anthropologist lived in the village.

daunting--adj.def: Seeming so difficult that it makes you lose confidence.
daunting--adj.ex: The task looked daunting at first.
daunting--adj.exTr: Görev ilk başta göz korkutucu görünüyordu.

resin--noun.def: A sticky substance from trees, or a similar artificial material.
resin--noun.ex: Resin ran down the pine trunk.

brainwashing--noun.def: Forcing someone to accept beliefs by constant pressure.

disdain--noun.def: The feeling that someone or something is worthless.
disdain--noun.ex: He looked at the offer with disdain.

blister--noun.def: A small bubble of fluid under the skin.
blister--noun.ex: The new boots gave him a blister.

blister--verb.def: To develop blisters, or to make paint bubble.
blister--verb.ex: The paint blistered in the sun.
